recipes.name: Hearty Stew
recipes.description: Meat, potato and onion left to simmer until the broth goes thick. The first pot anyone learns, and the one they keep coming back to.

recipes.name: Spiced Skewers
recipes.description: Fowl cut small, rolled in spice and cooked over the fire on a stick. No pot, no fuss, no leftovers.

recipes.name: Fish Chowder
recipes.description: Fish and potato simmered in cream until everything softens. Every river town cooks it, and every river town cooks it the same.

recipes.name: Berry Tart
recipes.description: Oats and butter pressed into a crust, filled with berries and baked on a hot stone. Sweet enough that nobody minds how plain it is.

recipes.name: Lentil Pottage
recipes.description: Lentils and barley boiled down with carrot until the spoon stands up in it. Cheap, filling, and hard to get wrong.

recipes.name: Mushroom Soup
recipes.description: Mushrooms and onion softened in the pot, then loosened with cream. The only trick is knowing which mushrooms.

recipes.name: Garden Broth
recipes.description: Tomato, greens and carrot cut small and boiled in clear broth. Ready before the fire has burned down.

recipes.name: Cheese Flatbread
recipes.description: Flatbread laid by the fire with cheese and sliced tomato on top until it blisters. Torn and shared, never cut.
